//regions: bom1 is Mumbai. This is not cosmetic: every user is in Bengaluru, the MongoDB Atlas cluster and the whole event corpus are India-region, and lib/format.ts pins all date formatting to Asia/Kolkata. A US default region would add a round trip to every query for zero benefit.
//crons: There are deliberately NO Vercel crons here. .github/workflows/daily-scrape.yml and daily-digest.yml run `npm run scrape` / `npm run send-digest` directly on a GitHub runner rather than calling an API route, so there is no shared secret to leak and no serverless timeout to fight — a full scrape takes 5-10 minutes and ~700 upstream requests, well past any serverless limit.
//env: Set these in the Vercel project, not here — this file is committed. Required: MONGODB_URI, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAILS. Optional: RESEND_API_KEY, ICA_*, NVIDIA_API_KEY, NVIDIA_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Run `npx tsx scripts/diag-deploy-readiness.ts` first — NEXTAUTH_URL in particular is invisible in development and makes sign-in impossible in production if unset.
//DEV_LOGIN: NEVER set DEV_LOGIN in a deployed environment. lib/dev-login.ts requires NODE_ENV !== 'production' as well, so it cannot activate on Vercel, but do not rely on one guard.
